item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate ran successfully for 30 epochs, with its best checkpoint at epoch 10 achieving validation HR@10 of 0.600 and NDCG@10 of 0.37344. Parallel local and dilated paths plausibly help combine immediate transitions with longer-range preferences. However, no baseline or ablation is provided, so these results do not establish that multiscale connectivity or removing position embeddings improved performance. No test metrics were reported.","code_summary":"Causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional shared input/candidate embeddings, maximum history length 128, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block combines parallel width-3 local and dilated convolutions, scaled by 1/sqrt(2), followed by another dilated convolution, with pre-layer normalization, GELU, and dropout 0.2. No absolute position embeddings. Padding is masked after each block; final normalized representations score items by dot product. Candidate scoring uses the last nonpadding position. LR=0.001, weight decay=0, batch size=128."}
